title: SPEAK LIFE AND VICTORY INTO THIS NEW WEEK
text: Beloved, I greet you in the matchless name of our Lord Jesus Christ. >> [music] >> As we stand at the threshold of this new week, I want you to understand that we are not stepping into ordinary days. We are stepping into divine orchestrations, into the fullness of what God has prepared for those who love him. The spirit of the Lord is upon me to minister to you, and I decree that as you receive this word, something shifts in your spirit, something changes in your atmosphere, and you will never remain the same again. You see, there is a principle in the kingdom that many believers have not understood. [music] It is the principle of prophetic utterance, the principle of speaking life. The Bible makes it abundantly clear in the book of Proverbs chapter 18 verse 21 that death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. This is not mere philosophy, this is spiritual technology. God has given you the ability to frame your world with your words. Before creation ever came into being, there was a voice. Genesis chapter 1 verse 3 records that God said, "Let there be light, and light was." The creative power of God was released through utterance, through declaration, through speaking. Now, listen to me carefully. You were made in the image and likeness of God. That means you carry creative capacity. That means your tongue is loaded with power. The question is, what have you been speaking? What have you been declaring over your life, over your family, over your business, over your destiny? [music] Many believers are suffering today not because God has abandoned them, not because the enemy is too powerful, but because they have not understood the ministry of their mouth. >> [music] >> They wake up every morning speaking death. They wake up declaring failure. They wake up reinforcing the very situations they are praying against. You cannot be praying for breakthrough and speaking breakdown. You cannot be asking God for victory, and your mouth is full of defeat. There must be alignment between your prayer life and your confession. The prophet Isaiah in chapter 55:11 gave us a powerful revelation. He said, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which >> [music] >> I please. And it shall prosper in the thing where to I sent it." If this is true about God's word, and you carry the very nature of God, then your words also carry weight in the realm of the spirit. Every word you speak is a seed. Every declaration you make is planting something either in the kingdom of darkness or in the kingdom of light. The Bible says in the book of Mark chapter 11:23 that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, "Be thou removed and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." Did you notice that the word say or saith appeared three times in that single verse? This shows you the premium that heaven places on your utterance. You must [music] learn to speak to your mountains. You must learn to prophesy to your situations. Stop complaining about what you are going through and start commanding it to change. The enemy wants you to use your mouth to describe your problems instead of using it to decree your victory. But I have come to tell you this morning, this afternoon, this evening, wherever you are receiving this word, that this is your week of supernatural turn around. This is your week of divine visitation. This is your week where the power of God shows up in your situation, and everything that has refused to bow must bow now. I want you to share this message with someone. The Bible says in the book of Romans chapter 10:17 that faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. When you share this word, you are not just doing someone a favor, >> [music] >> you are becoming a vessel through which faith is transmitted. You are becoming a channel through which heaven releases blessing. There is somebody in your contact list. There is somebody in your family. There is somebody in your sphere of influence that needs to hear this word. The spirit of God is saying, "Do not keep this to yourself. Release it. Let it go viral in the spirit realm. Let it travel from house to house, from nation to nation, because this is not ordinary preaching. This is prophetic instruction. This is divine intelligence for kingdom advancement. Now, as we prepare [music] to pray, I want to establish something in your spirit. Prayer is not begging God. Prayer is enforcing the will of heaven on earth. Jesus taught us to pray, "Thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven." This means that there is a reality in heaven that must be reproduced on earth, and prayer is the vehicle through which that transference happens. When you pray, you are not trying to convince God to do something. You are aligning yourself with what he has already ordained. You are positioning yourself to receive what he has already released. The problem with many believers is that they pray without understanding. They pray without revelation. They pray without authority. But the Bible says in the book of Ephesians chapter 6 verse 12, that we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. This tells you that there is a war going on. There is a conflict between the kingdom of God and the kingdom of darkness. And whether you like it or not, you are a target. The enemy is not sleeping. He's strategizing. He's planning. He's deploying demons to frustrate your destiny, to abort your purpose, to steal your joy, to kill your vision, and to destroy your future. But I have good news for you. The Bible says in 1 John chapter 4 verse 4, "Greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world." You are not a victim, you are a victor. You are not defenseless, you are dangerous. You carry the resurrection power of Jesus [music] Christ. You have been given authority to trample upon serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. So, when we pray, we are not hoping that something will happen. We are making something happen. We are releasing the power of God into our [music] situations. We are pulling down strongholds. We are casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. We are bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. This is militant prayer. This is violent faith. And the Bible says in the book of Matthew chapter 11 verse 12, that from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force. You must be violent in the spirit. You must be aggressive in prayer. You must be ruthless against the kingdom of darkness. Listen to me, beloved. The week that is ahead of you is pregnant with possibilities. There are divine appointments waiting for you. There are open doors that have your name on them. There are breakthroughs that are about to manifest. There are testimonies that are about to be born, but you must understand that the enemy also knows this. He knows what God has prepared for you, and he will do everything possible to stop you from accessing it. He will send discouragement. He will send fear. He will send destructions. He will send delays. He will send doubt, but you must be resolute. You must be focused. You must be determined that no matter what comes against you, you will not bow, you will not bend, and you will not break. The story of Caleb in the book of Joshua chapter 14 is very instructive. After 45 years of waiting, after all the giants and all the battles and all the challenges, at 85 years old, Caleb stood up and said, "Give me this mountain." He did not say, "I am too old. He did not say I am too tired. He did not say I have suffered enough. No. He said, "Give me this mountain." He understood that age is not a barrier to divine fulfillment. He understood that past disappointments do not determine future accomplishments. He understood that what God has promised, he is faithful to perform. And I decree over your life right now that this is your season of mountain possession. Everything the enemy has stolen from you, you are taking it back. Every territory the devil has occupied in your life, you are repossessing it. Every blessing that has been delayed, it is being released [music] now. The prophet Ezekiel in chapter 37 had a powerful encounter. God took him to a valley full of dry bones and asked him, "Can these bones [music] live?" Ezekiel responded, "O Lord God, thou knowest." Then God commanded him to prophesy [music] to the bones. Notice that God did not ask Ezekiel to pray for the bones. He asked him to prophesy to them. There is a difference between praying and prophesying. When you pray, you are talking to God about your situation. When you prophesy, you are talking to your situation about God. Prayer is vertical communication. Prophecy is horizontal confrontation. And sometimes what you need is not another prayer session, but a prophetic declaration. So Ezekiel began to speak to the dead bones. And as he spoke, there was a noise, a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone. Sinews appeared. Flesh came upon them. Skin covered them, but there was no breath in them. Then God told him to prophesy to the wind, and when he did, breath entered them, and they stood up, an exceeding great army. This is what happens when you speak life. This is what happens when you make prophetic declarations. Dead situations come alive. Impossible circumstances become possible. What looked finished gets resurrected. And I am telling you by the spirit of God that as you pray today, as you make declarations over your life this week, there will be a stirring in the spirit. Things that have been dead will resurrect. Opportunities that died will come back to life. Relationships that were finished will be restored. Finances that dried up will overflow again. But you must speak. You must open your mouth and decree a thing. The Bible says in the book of Job chapter 22 verse 28, "Thou shall also decree a thing and it shall be established onto thee and the light shall shine upon thy ways." God is not going to decree for you. He has given you the authority to decree for yourself. He has empowered you. He has anointed you. He has qualified you. Now you must exercise that authority. You must activate that power. You must function in that anointing. Stop waiting for a prophet to speak over your life when God has already made you a prophet in your own sphere. Stop waiting for someone to pray for you when God has already given you access to the throne of grace. Stop being a spectator in your own deliverance and become a participant. I want you to understand something very critical. Victory is not what you are praying for. Victory is what you are enforcing. When Jesus died on the cross and said it is finished, he was not making a wish. He was making a declaration. He was announcing that the work of redemption was complete. He was proclaiming that the power of sin was broken. He was establishing that the authority of Satan was destroyed. [music] And 3 days later when he rose from the dead, he validated that declaration. He confirmed that victory. And now because you are in Christ, that victory is your inheritance. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians chapter 15 verse 57, "But thanks be [music] to God which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ." Notice he says giveth us the victory, not will give us the victory. It is present tense. It is current reality. It is finished transaction. You already have the victory. The problem is that you have not known it, you have not believed it, you have not walked in it, you have not declared it, but today is the day that changes. Today is the day you wake up to your identity in Christ. Today is the day you realize that you are not fighting for victory, you are fighting from victory. The war has already been won. The battle has already been settled. All you need to do is enforce it, implement it, demonstrate it, and manifest it. The Apostle Paul understood this. That is why in the book of Romans chapter 8 verse 37 he said, "Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. We are not trying to be conquerors. We are not hoping to become conquerors. We are already more than conquerors. That means before the battle even starts, we have already won. Before the challenge even shows up, we have already overcome. Before the enemy even makes a move, we have already defeated him. This is the confidence of a believer who understands his position in Christ. [music] This is the boldness of a Christian who knows his authority in the kingdom. Now, somebody might ask, "If we have already won, why do we still face challenges? Why do we still go through trials? Why do we still encounter difficulties?" The answer is simple. The victory has been won positionally, but it must be appropriated personally. What Jesus did on the cross is available to every believer, but not every believer is walking in it. Not every Christian is experiencing it. Not every child of God is manifesting it. Why? Because they have not taken hold of it by faith. They have not possessed their possession. They have not claimed their inheritance. They are like the children of Israel who came out of Egypt but never entered Canaan. They were delivered from bondage, but never experienced the fullness of God's promise. And this is the tragedy of many believers today. They are born again, they are saved, they are going to heaven, but on earth they are living defeated lives. They are struggling with issues that Jesus already conquered. They are wrestling with problems that have already been solved at Calvary. They have been oppressed by demons that have already been disarmed at the cross. But I'm telling you today that your days of defeat are over. Your season of struggle is finished. Your era of failure has expired. This week, you are entering into a new dimension of victory. This week, you are walking into a new level of breakthrough. This week, you are stepping into the manifestation of everything that God [music] has spoken over your life. The time to pray is now, not later, not tomorrow, not when you feel like it, now, right now. Wherever you are, whatever you are doing, I want you to create a moment. I want you to separate yourself. I want you to position yourself to receive from heaven. Turn off the distractions. Silence the noise. Quiet your heart. Open your spirit and get ready to engage in prophetic warfare. Get ready to release the sound of victory. Get ready to decree the word of the Lord over your life. And as you pray, do not pray small prayers, do not pray religious prayers, do not pray maintenance prayers, pray kingdom prayers, pray heaven-shaking prayers, pray earth-changing prayers, pray destiny-altering prayers. In the book of Genesis chapter 32, Jacob wrestled with the angel of the Lord all night and refused to let go until he received a blessing. That is the kind of tenacity you need this week. That is the kind of determination you need in your prayer life. That is the kind of desperation you need for breakthrough. Jacob said, "I will not let thee go except thou bless me." And because of his persistence, his name was changed from Jacob to Israel, which means prince with [music] God. He went from being a supplanter to being royalty. He went from being a deceiver to being a victor. And I prophesy over your life that this week, there is a divine name change happening. There is a spiritual transformation taking place. There is a supernatural promotion being released. You will no longer be called by your past mistakes. You will no longer be identified by your failures. You will no longer be labeled by your struggles. You are getting a new name. You are receiving a new identity. You are stepping into a new season. And everything that has been against you will begin to work for you. Every enemy that has risen against you will become your footstool. Every giant that has intimidated you will fall before you. Every mountain that has blocked your path will be removed. Every door that has been shut will be opened. Every opportunity that has been denied will be granted. Every blessing that has been delayed will be accelerated. Listen to the word of the Lord. The spirit of God says this is your week of divine turnaround. What I have started in your life I will complete. What I have promised I will fulfill. What I have spoken, I will establish. No weapon against you shall prosper. No tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. >> [music] >> No plan of the enemy against you shall succeed. I am fighting for you. I am working for you. I am opening doors for you. I am making ways for you. I am releasing favor upon your life. I am pouring out blessings upon your household. I am accelerating your destiny. I am manifesting my glory in your situation. And by the end of this week you will testify. You will celebrate. You will rejoice. For I am the Lord your God and I change not. Now as we go into prayer, I need you to pray with [music] understanding. I need you to pray with authority. I need you to pray with faith. Do not just repeat words. Engage your spirit. Activate your faith. Release your voice and heaven will respond. Angels will be dispatched. Demons will be scattered. Strongholds will be shattered and victory will be yours. Father, I thank you for everyone who is receiving this word right now. I thank you because your word does not [music] return void, but accomplishes what it was sent to do. I thank you for the power of the spoken word. I thank you for the authority you have given us in Christ Jesus. And right now, in the name of Jesus, I take authority over every assignment of darkness that is targeted against any life listening to this message. Every demon that has been sent, I command you to go back to your sender. Every witchcraft operation, I cancel you now. Every marine covenant, I break you. Every ancestral curse, I revoke you. Every generational bondage, I destroy you. Every satanic embargo against prosperity, against promotion, against progress, I dismantle you now in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak life over every dead situation. I prophesy resurrection over every failed project. I decree restoration over every broken relationship. I declare recovery over every stolen blessing. In the name of Jesus, let there be light in every area of darkness. Let there be breakthrough in every area of stagnation. Let there be opening in every area of closure. Let there be advancement in every area of limitation. Let there be multiplication in every area of reduction. Let there be acceleration in every area of delay. Let there be manifestation in every area of frustration. Let there be celebration in every area [music] of devastation. I decree that this week, divine helpers will locate you. Uncommon doors will open for you. Supernatural favor will rest upon you. Unusual opportunities will come to you. Strategic connections will align with you. Financial breakthroughs will visit you. Spiritual elevation will happen to you. Ministerial expansion will come upon you. Marital settlement will manifest for you. Academic excellence will be your portion. Business success will be your testimony. Career promotion will be your reality. Divine help will be your experience. Angelic protection will be your covering. And the glory of God will be your permanent address. Every power that is saying no to your yes, I command you to release your hold now. Every strongman that is holding your blessings, I command you to let go now. Every gatekeeper of darkness that is blocking your access, I command you to be removed now. Every spiritual embargo be lifted. Every satanic barricade be destroyed. Every demonic checkpoint be dismantled. Every witchcraft monitor be blinded. Every household wickedness be paralyzed. Every envious enemy be disgraced. Every jealous adversary be disappointed in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy that this week you will receive news that will make you dance. You will hear testimonies that will make you shout. You will see manifestations that will make you weep for joy. You will experience breakthroughs that will make you worship. You will encounter the supernatural that will make you believe again. You will witness the miraculous that will restore your hope. You will enjoy divine interventions that will silence your mockers. You will celebrate victories that will shock your enemies. You will receive blessings that will surprise your doubters. And you will walk in a dimension of glory that will confound the wise. I speak to your body right now. Every sickness, I command you to leave. Every disease, I command you to go. Every pain, I command you to cease. Every affliction, I command you to depart. In the name of Jesus, let divine health flood every system. Let supernatural healing invade every organ. Let miraculous restoration repair every damage from the crown of your head to the sole of your feet. I decree wholeness. I decree soundness. I decree strength. I decree vitality. I decree energy. I decree wellness. Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit and no infirmity has the right to dwell there. Cancer, get out. Diabetes, get out. Hypertension, get out. Fibroid, get out. Ulcer, get out. Every stubborn ailment, get out now in Jesus' name. I speak to your finances. Every devourer, I command you to stop. Every waster, I command you to cease. Every leakage in your income, I command it to be sealed now. Every source of financial loss, I command it to be blocked now. Every door of poverty, I command it to be shut now. And every door of prosperity, I command it to be opened now. In the name of Jesus, I release [music] the spirit of multiplication upon your life. What you have in your hand will not diminish but increase. Your little will become much. Your scarcity will become abundance. Your lack will become overflow. Your insufficiency will become surplus. You will lend to nations and not borrow. You will be the head and not the tail. You will be above only and not beneath. The wealth of the sinners is laid up for you and you will receive it this week. I speak to your marriage. Every force of divorce, I bind you. Every spirit of separation, I cast you out. Every root of bitterness, I uproot you. Every seed of unforgiveness, I destroy you. In the name of Jesus, I release the spirit of love. I release the spirit of understanding. I release the spirit of patience. I release the spirit of peace. I release the spirit of unity. I release the spirit of forgiveness. I release the spirit of restoration. Your marriage will not fail. Your home will not collapse. Your family will not scatter. I decree that your spouse will love you more. Your children will honor you more. Your household will prosper more and your [music] home will become a center of divine visitation. I speak to those believing God for the fruit of the womb. Every spirit of barrenness, I rebuke you. Every power of delay, I cancel you. Every satanic manipulation of your reproductive system, I destroy you now. In the name of Jesus, I open your womb. I command conception to take place. I decree that you will carry to full term. I prophesy safe delivery. I declare that you will nurse your own children. The reproach of barrenness is over. The season of waiting is finished. Your time has come. Your breakthrough has arrived. Before this year runs out, you will carry your baby. You will testify of God's faithfulness. You will celebrate the goodness of the Lord. I speak to your destiny. Every satanic cage be broken now. Every spiritual prison be shattered now. Every demonic limitation be destroyed now. Every evil covenant be nullified now. Every ancestral agreement be canceled now. Every marine contract be terminated now. In the name of Jesus, I release you into your divine purpose. I release you into your God-ordained assignment. I release you into your prophetic destiny. You will fulfill all that God has called you to do. You will accomplish all that God has purposed for you to accomplish. You will become all that God has destined you to become. Your life will count. Your existence will matter. Your presence will make a difference, and generations yet unborn will celebrate your name. I prophesy acceleration over your life. What should take 10 years will happen in 1 year. What should take 12 months will happen in 1 month. What should take 4 weeks will happen in 1 week. What should take 7 days will happen in 1 day. What should take 24 hours will happen in 1 hour. God is speeding up your process. He is fast-tracking your promotion. He is accelerating your advancement. You are entering the era of suddenly. Suddenly, things will change. Suddenly, doors will open. Suddenly, help will come. Suddenly, breakthrough will manifest. Suddenly, you will be celebrated. Suddenly, you will be promoted. Suddenly, you will be elevated. This is your season of the supernatural. Every power that has vowed that you will not succeed, I command thunder and lightning of God to locate them now. Every enemy that has sworn that you will not prosper, I command the judgment of God to visit them now. Every adversary that has plotted that you will not advance, I command the sword of the Lord to strike them now. Let the angel of the Lord pursue them. Let their way be dark and slippery. Let destruction come upon them unawares. Let their nets that they have hidden catch themselves. Into that very destruction, let them fall. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree that this week, you are untouchable. You are unreachable by the forces of darkness. You are invisible to demonic monitoring. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. You are surrounded by the fire of God. You are protected by angelic hosts. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling. No weapon fashioned against you shall prosper. No tongue that rises against you in judgment shall succeed. You are shielded. You are guarded. You are defended. You are preserved. [music] You are kept. And you will come out of this week without a scratch, without a scar, without a loss, without a setback, but with testimonies, with blessings, with [music] promotions, with breakthroughs, and with victories. I speak to your mind. Every tormenting thought get out. Every fearful imagination be cast down. Every negative suggestion be rejected. Every spirit of depression be expelled. Every attack of anxiety be repelled in the name of Jesus. I release the peace of God that passes all understanding. I release the joy of the Lord that is your strength. I release the soundness of mind that belongs to you in Christ. You will not lose your mind. You will not break down mentally. You will not be overwhelmed emotionally. Your mind is the mind of Christ. Your thoughts are the [music] thoughts of faith. Your imagination is sanctified. Your emotions are stable, and your mental health is secured in Jesus name. I speak victory over your career. Every ceiling be shattered. Every obstacle be removed. Every hindrance be cleared. In the name of Jesus, I decree promotion. I decree elevation. I decree recognition. I decree appreciation. I decree recommendation. I decree celebration. Your superiors will notice you. Your bosses will favor you. Your employers will appreciate you. Your colleagues will respect you. Your work will speak for you. Your diligence will recommend you. Your excellence will promote you. And your faithfulness will celebrate you. You are going higher. You are moving forward. You are advancing rapidly, and nothing will stop you. I speak to students and scholars. Every spirit of failure get out. Every power [music] of dullness be removed. Every attack against your memory >> [music] >> be destroyed. In the name of Jesus, I release the spirit of wisdom. I release the spirit of understanding. I release the spirit of knowledge. I release the spirit of retention. I release the spirit of excellence. I release the spirit of distinction. You will not fail your exams. You will not repeat your class. You will not [music] drop out of school. You will excel. You will graduate. You will succeed. Your results will shock your teachers. Your performance will amaze your lecturers. Your grades will confound your critics. And your success will silence your mockers. I speak to ministers of the gospel. Every attack against your ministry, I nullify it. Every conspiracy against your calling, I destroy it. Every witchcraft against your anointing, I break it. In the name of Jesus, I release fresh fire. I release new wine. I release deeper dimensions. I release greater glory. I release unusual favor. I release supernatural expansion. Your ministry will grow. Your influence will increase. Your impact [music] will multiply. Your effectiveness will advance. Your fruit will abound. And your legacy will endure. I speak to businessmen and entrepreneurs. Every spirit of loss, get out. Every power of failure, be destroyed. Every demon of bankruptcy, be bound. In the name of Jesus, I release the spirit of prosperity. I release the spirit of success. I release the spirit of increase. I release the spirit of profitability. I release the spirit of sustainability. I release the spirit of expansion. Your business will thrive. Your company will flourish. Your enterprise will succeed. Your investments will yield. Your profits will multiply. And your wealth will increase. Now, lift your voice wherever you are and begin to thank God. Begin to praise him. Begin to worship him. For he has [music] heard your prayers. He has answered your cry. He has granted your petitions. Victory is yours. Breakthrough is yours. Success is yours. Prosperity is yours. Health is yours. Peace is yours. Joy is yours. Favor is yours. Promotion is yours. Elevation is yours. And glory is yours in Jesus mighty name. Amen and amen.
